definitions.gloss: price increase, rise in price, appreciation
definitions.explanation: A rise in the price or value of goods, services, or assets. Describes an upward change in price from the consumer's or market perspective.

examples.japanese: {食品|しょくひん}が{値上|ねあ}がりした。
{電気代|でんきだい}の{値上|ねあ}がりが{家計|かけい}を{圧迫|あっぱく}している。
examples.english: Rising electricity costs are putting pressure on household finances.

examples.japanese: {原材料|げんざいりょう}の{値上|ねあ}がりにより、{多|おお}くの{商品|しょうひん}の{価格|かかく}が{見直|みなお}されている。
examples.english: Due to the rise in raw material prices, the prices of many products are being reviewed.

notes:
The opposite is {値下|ねさ}がり (price decrease). A related but different term is {値上|ねあ}げ (a deliberate price hike by a seller), whereas {値上|ねあ}がり describes the price going up on its own or from external factors.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
・{値上|ねあ}がりが{続|つづ}く (prices continue to rise)
・{大幅|おおはば}な{値上|ねあ}がり (significant price increase)
・{株価|かぶか}の{値上|ねあ}がり (stock price appreciation)
・{値上|ねあ}がりを{見込|みこ}む (expect prices to rise)
